en.answer:
Yes, you can.

The part of the effect that prevents you from Special Summoning any Level 5 or higher monsters the turn you use that effect is only applied if you successfully Special Summon <<9748>> with that effect.
en.question: If you control a face-up "Ice Barrier" monster and I Special Summon <<9748>> from my hand with its own effect, and that Special Summon is negated, can I Special Summon Level 5 or higher monsters during that turn?
en.title: If the Special Summon of <<9748>> is negated, can I Special Summon Level 5 or higher monsters during that turn?

ja.answer:
できます。
